events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
Hi, this Maria Alvarez, born 03/14/1968. I need a refill of my lorazepam. I've only got two left.
Thanks, one moment while I check.

Lorazepam is handled directly by the prescribing team and cannot be requested on this line. Please contact the Cedar Clinic prescription desk on five five five, zero one four two, open weekdays from eight in the morning to six in the evening.
Can't you just send it anyway? It's on my record.
I’m sorry, I can’t send a request for controlled medicines on this line. Please contact the Cedar Clinic prescription desk on five five five, zero one four two.
